notes:
### Added

- A board pipeline can pick up only the tickets assigned to you (Settings › Projects › Pipeline, Only tickets assigned to me); tickets assigned to someone else or to nobody stay in the column. Trello and Linear cards now know when they are yours too, as Productive and GitHub Projects already did (#558)
- **`/btw` side questions**: type `/btw <question>` in a Claude conversation to ask something about it without interrupting Claude. The answer shows in a small card above the composer, also while Claude is working, and is not added to the conversation. Ask again to follow up; × or Esc closes the card (#559)
- Continue a Claude Code conversation on claude.ai or the Claude phone app: right-click it in the sidebar and pick Continue on phone. A phone icon in the title bar shows it is on, with the link to open or copy and Stop; what you type on the phone shows up in the conversation. (#562)
- Settings › Agents lists the skills Claude Code has in your vault, from you, the project or a plugin, and ⌘K gets "Reload skills and plugins" to pick up a skill or plugin you just added without starting a new conversation (#564).
- **MCP servers in Settings › Agents › Claude Code**: the servers Claude has in the vault with their state (connected, failed with its error, needs sign-in, starting, off). Sign in to one that needs it (the page opens in your browser; a claude.ai connector is connected on claude.ai), reconnect a failed one, or switch one off or on. New conversations pick up the change; running ones keep the servers they have (#565)
- Claude Code now suggests your next message after a turn: it shows grey in the empty message field, and Tab or the right arrow takes it. Claude Code's own setting `promptSuggestionEnabled` turns it off. (#566)
- **Where each Claude conversation stands**: after each turn Claude Code writes a one-line status, which shows in small text under the conversation's title in the sidebar. When the turn ended on something only you can do (a question, a choice), the conversation gets the blue dot until you answer. Not kept over a restart; the next turn writes it again (#561)
- Background tasks in a Claude conversation: what Claude has running (commands, subagents) is listed above the message box with its state and time, a command shows its output on a click and a hover icon stops it, and the list folds away under its header line; while Claude works, the line shows what it is doing now. (#563)

### Changed

- A board pipeline's Mark done is now **Ignore**, and it can be undone: the pipeline leaves an ignored ticket alone wherever it is on the board (no pick-up, no moves, no PR follow-up, its agent stops if it runs) and no longer moves it to the merged column. The ignored tickets are listed under Up next in the pipeline's strip, each with **Unignore**, which hands it back to the pipeline from where it was. The pipeline's conversation does both too (`ignore`, `unignore`), also for a ticket still waiting in the pick column. An ignored ticket a person moves to a done column leaves the list (#568)
- Each conversation keeps its own Artifact drawer: switching to another conversation and back opens the same artifact again, in the view you picked (This Mac or claude.ai), and a drawer you closed stays closed. The agents column comes back the same way; the terminal, Git and files drawers still follow the open conversation (#567)
